  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spvs) as total_spvs,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM distributions WHERE status = 'Paid') as paid_distributions,
  (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM distributions WHERE status = 'Paid') as total_paid_amount
